Financial Quickview.

https://quietlight.com/listings/13953957?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=28165

 

Detailed Description.   This business is not SBA eligible. The low multiple on

this longstanding business is to attract cash buyers.

This business sells a high-converting continuity product in the

tactical/survival niche. Most revenue comes through affiliates who drive traffic

to long-form landing pages. Year-to-date, the average CPA is $23.46, while the

average customer lifetime value is approximately $97. These numbers have

supported consistent seven-figure earnings over several years.

While trailing revenue has moderated from its 2024 peak, trailing 12-month

earnings have improved, and net margins have almost doubled. This growth

reflects a deliberate shift toward profitability and higher-quality customer

cohorts over top-line growth.

With this business, a driven buyer acquires strong cash flows based on recurring

subscriptions, a loyal network of affiliates, and the opportunity to pursue

multiple untapped growth channels. A meaningful portion of future earnings has

already been built. A new owner will have the margins and buffer to focus on

strategy and launch new initiatives.

The 225,000-plus email list remains underutilized. The business has never

engaged in any paid advertising or social media. Since all revenue comes through

its affiliate network, actions such as attending industry conferences,

recruiting additional affiliates, and strengthening existing relationships could

all pay dividends. New products and higher-level membership tiers could increase

LTV. The core direct-response infrastructure could also extend to adjacent

markets like health, wellness, or financial publishing.

The sellers have been largely absentee, working a combined 3–5 hours per week

while a full-time General Manager and established team handle operations

independently. They are seeking to redeploy capital to other ventures. The team

is expected to remain.

An ideal buyer grasps the direct response model and affiliate marketing, and

understands that this is not a traditional ecommerce brand.  

 

 

Request an info packet.   The average Quiet Light listing receives 3 offers,

often within days of listing. Inquire now to get a leg up on other buyers.  

Inquire Now

https://quietlight.com/listings/13953957?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=28165

  No obligation or financial commitment.

Key Benefits.  

Turnkey Operation   Currently run by a qualified general manager with a small

team, the business is staffed to grow.

Attractive to Affiliates   The brand has a track record for paying out strong

commissions on a timely basis, and many affiliates reach out to promote its

offers.

89% Gross Margins   Product costs represent a small fraction of revenue,

providing resilience against cost fluctuations and leaving substantial room for

investment in growth.

Diversified Offer Portfolio   No single offer represents an overwhelming share

of revenue. The top offer contributes roughly 13% of sales.

Strong, Recurring Cash Flow   The business generates substantial cash flow from

subscriptions.
